evidence: src/requests/adapters.py:103-109: client_cert is passed to pools as cert_file and key_file while the globally shared context is used for verify=True.
findings.suggested_fix: Keep the preloaded trust roots, but give pools or TLS connections using client certificates their own SSLContext before urllib3 loads a certificate into it.
findings.title: Shared SSL context leaks client certificates across requests

testing_gaps: No existing test supplies a CA directory as verify=... Existing TLS tests cover default verification failure, verify=False, and custom CA bundle files (tests/test_requests.py:2892,2923), but do not exercise the new directory-selection branch at src/requests/adapters.py:97-100 or cert_verify's directory assignment at lines 314-317. A locally trusted TLS server test using a hashed CA directory would cover this path.
